requirements.invariant: Explicit states and strict typed contracts
Scoped references and evidence freshness
Deterministic exact-byte snapshot binding
Candidate content cannot approve itself
Hard constraints and conflicts are resolved before preference ranking
Unknown and inapplicable conditional evidence never become fabricated negative facts
Decision conditions consume factual state with component and project scope isolation
Facet previews reuse the deterministic decision core without mutating project facts
Supersession cannot silently rewrite the active decision surface
Candidate knowledge is source-backed, scoped, deterministic and cannot self-promote to Reviewed
License identities preserve exact only/or-later semantics
Knowledge promotion requires complete hash-bound external human review
Checked-in Reviewed knowledge exactly reproduces the hash-approved candidate and still requires caller-supplied snapshot approval
Browser validation consumes the same static schema set without filesystem coupling or schema-digest drift
UI facet selections materialize only deterministic ui.facet.* canonical constraints and preserve foreign project state
UI results and facet counts reuse evaluateDecision and facetCounts; sorting changes presentation only
Browser runtime remains fail-closed until an externally supplied trusted snapshot digest passes verifySnapshot
Browser shell uses safe DOM content APIs and deterministic browser-only build output
Product facets are derived only from approved Reviewed boolean dimensions and fail closed on missing or type-mismatched dimensions
Free-text rules, normalization and matching are bounded, deterministic and abstain on unsupported or ambiguous input
Confirmed text proposals are materially equivalent to selecting the same authoritative facets manually
Stage 4 text assistance remains local-only and introduces no network or dynamic-code execution surface
Text analysis stays outside canonical project state and only explicit PROPOSED confirmation reaches the existing facet path
GitHub Pages deployment trust requires a strict deployment profile that separately pins the Reviewed source manifest and approved runtime projection
The Pages runtime is a minimal deterministic projection of exactly approved Reviewed documents and rejects source, allowlist or projection digest drift
Deployment-only runtime trust cannot leak into the ordinary browser build; Pages output is deterministic and injects approval material only in the deployment artifact
Generated Pages bytes contain no dynamic-code, network or credential surface and browser-reachable schema validation uses reproducible precompiled validators
Pages deployment is chained to the exact successful same-repository main Verify SHA with stale-main rejection and least-privilege deployment permissions
Freshness maintenance is deterministic, explicit-time and advisory only; expired or review-due claims produce candidates without inferred replacement facts
Dictionary contribution intake remains untrusted candidate material and preserves the Stage 4 schema, ambiguity, conflict and equivalence regression burden
Community PR assistance classifies changed review surfaces deterministically from paths while trusted base-branch tooling remains isolated from untrusted PR code
Community automation is read-only advisory evidence and cannot approve, promote, merge or mutate repository knowledge or contribution state
Beta release identity binds version, tag, title, prerelease status, exact asset set and protected-main target
Beta coverage and limitations explicitly separate the live Pages decision surface from Reviewed-but-not-live licensing knowledge
Release artifacts are deterministic, checksummed and evidence-bound across Pages archive, CycloneDX SBOM and publication manifest
Release build authority is read-only and source-executing while publication authority is write-capable and executes no repository source
Public Beta publication requires an exact-SHA verified draft prerelease and immutable release integrity; unpublished-draft cleanup cannot mutate a published release
Published release evidence is baseline-bound and corrections supersede immutable releases instead of silently replacing them
